name: bespunky-house
description: The BeSpunky house standard for any repo, as a stack of detected layers on an Nx floor: the agent DX (composed devcontainer, Claude settings, window identity, HOUSE docs) by default; Node, JS libraries, the stack-free web dev loop, Angular, a design system, navigation or Firebase only when worn. /bespunky-house:new creates a project, /bespunky-house:upgrade migrates one to the current standard, /bespunky-house:add-layer adds a layer. Generator-first; consented, never automatic.
